name: ANTI-TPO
description: Anti-TPO measures thyroid peroxidase antibodies and evaluates autoimmune thyroid disease. This test diagnoses Hashimoto's thyroiditis and Graves' disease, and predicts thyroid dysfunction risk.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Anti-TPO (Thyroid Peroxidase Antibodies) are markers of autoimmune thyroid disease. Normal <34 IU/mL. Positive in Hashimoto's thyroiditis (95% of cases) and Graves' disease (70% of cases). High titers predict progression to hypothyroidism in euthyroid patients. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides high sensitivity and specificity. Used in evaluation of goiter, thyroid dysfunction, and pregnancy loss. Positive antibodies indicate autoimmune etiology. Also associated with other autoimmune diseases. Critical for distinguishing autoimmune from non-autoimmune thyroid disorders. Results guide prognosis and monitoring in thyroid autoimmune disease.
